params.caption: 🎮 No disc in your GTA 6 box? KFC Spain will give you a chicken one GTA 6's retail box ships with a download code instead of a disc, and KFC Spain is poking fun at it with a "Replace the Disc" campaign. Bring your GTA 6 box to KFC in Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia and other Spanish cities on December 19–20 (4–8 PM) and get a free disc-shaped piece of fried chicken. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 23:22 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @RockstarGames 🍗 React 😂 if you'd go · 💬 Would you rather have the real disc? #GTA6 #KFC #Rockstar #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
